deployment_notes: Paid plan and disk require owner approval before application. Active render.yaml remains Free.
Update the existing Blueprint after approval; do not create a duplicate service.
Set secrets directly in Render. Do not copy the Tripo CLI credential from its local config.
Existing ephemeral sessions do not automatically migrate to the new disk; current uploaded references may need to be uploaded again.
A disk-backed service has one instance and a short interruption during deployment.
Verify runtime write permissions under /var/data for container UID 10001 and confirm provider config reports available before any paid generation.
Keep SQLite-native backups separately; a disk snapshot is not a substitute for a consistent database backup.
